cohort: 1232 neonates born over a period of one year in a secondary care hospital of south India.
finding: The study found that the majority of low birth weight neonates were female and experienced minimal postnatal complications.
mod_finding: 46% of low birth weight babies were born via cesarean section compared to 5% of normal birth weight babies.
gest_age: 50% of LBW babies were born at term
birth_weight: Low birth weight (<2500g, assumed based on the topic of the study)
